On Thu, 25 Feb 2027 at 09:45 AM Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@acme.com> wrote:
> Thanks Marissa  the recap is spot on. A few quick clarifying questions before we share the questionnaire: 
> 
> 1) Immutability: can you confirm whether logs are stored with a write-once/read-many model (S3 Object Lock or equivalent) and whether retention windows can be configured per-customer? We need to show auditability to our legal team.
> 2) Export formats: JSONL is preferred, but some of our security tooling ingests CSV. Do you support both? Do you have a sample export we can ingest into our test pipeline?
> 3) PII handling: for API request/response logs, do you retain full request bodies or do you redact PII fields by default?

Hi Tom  answers below; copying Aditya and Dev so they can join the deep-dive and provide any additional technical detail: 

- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II attestation (attached). The report covers control categories relevant to logging, access, and change management.
- Immutability & retention: Logs can be pushed to a customer-owned S3 with Object Lock enabled for WORM/immutability, or stored in Redwood-managed buckets with per-customer retention policies. Retention windows are configurable per-customer and per-log-type (admin/API/audit).
- Export formats: We support JSONL (preferred for line-delimited events) and CSV exports via the Console or the Logs Export API. We can also stream logs to your SIEM (S3/HTTP) for real-time ingestion. Sample attached: Audit-logging-sample-export.jsonl (synthetic data).
- PII handling: Request/response bodies are redacted by default for known sensitive fields (credit_card, ssn, medical_identifiers). We also offer configurable redaction rules for custom fields. Full unredacted bodies are not retained unless explicitly enabled in a dedicated customer contract and logged as a security exception.

Technical bullets (what you'll see in exports):
- Admin activity logs: timestamp, actor_email, action, target_resource, ip_address, request_id, audit_level
- API logs: timestamp, request_id, method, endpoint, status_code, latency_ms, truncated_request_body_hash, response_size_bytes
- Exportability: Console CSV/JSONL, programmatic Logs Export API, scheduled S3 deliveries (daily/hourly).

Proposed next step: Security deep-dive on Fri 2/26 10:00 PT with Aditya (security engineer) and Dev (platform). We'll be prepared to show a short live export and a sample ingestion into a test pipeline.

Let me know if procurement needs the BAA contact now  I can route that request to our legal team.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Audit-logging-sample-export.jsonl
